postconditions.description: The output must consist of exactly n lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line) == m for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: Each line in the output must contain exactly m characters.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '.*' for line in stdout.splitlines() for c in line)
postconditions.description: Each character in the output must be either '.' (white) or '*' (black).

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for c in line if c == '*') == a[i] for i, line in enumerate(stdout.splitlines()))
postconditions.description: The number of black segments in each row must match the corresponding value in the list a.

postconditions.expression: all(sum(1 for line in stdout.splitlines() if line[j] == '*') == b[j] for j in range(m))
